name: Knife Skills
body: Technique; Upgrade a starter card by up to 2.

name: Clean Station
body: Technique; Peel up to 2 starter cards.

name: Taste Test
body: Technique; Draw 2 then discard 1.

name: Heckle
body: Technique; Give your opponent a Distraction.

name: Perfect
body: Technique; Choose a Dish. Double its Taste this turn.

name: Mock
body: Reaction; Choose opponent's highest-Taste presented dish. It gets -2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.

name: Drown in Butter
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent's presented dish. If it is not French it gets -3 Taste this turn.

name: Mine Is Better
body: Reaction; Reveal a Dish from your hand. If it has more Taste than an opponent's presented dish that dish gets -3 Taste this turn.

name: Bon Appetit!
body: Technique; Draw 1. During judging if one of your dishes has 5 or more Taste gain +2 Favor.

name: Supersize Me!
body: Technique; During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.

name: More Meat!
body: Technique; Tags: Meat.; Your Meat dishes get +1 Taste this turn. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Deep Fry
body: Technique; Tags: Fried.; Choose a Dish. It becomes Fried this turn and gets +2 Taste.

name: Party
body: Technique; Draw 1. During judging if you present at least 3 dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Ketchup Me That
body: Technique; Tags: Meat, Fried.; Choose a Meat or Fried dish. It gets +2 Taste.

name: Appropriate
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent's presented dish. After opponent scores steal that dish and add it to your discard pile. Peel Appropriate.

name: Purify
body: Technique; Peel 2.

name: Order
body: Technique; Draw 2 then put 1 card from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Omakase
body: Technique; Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Present it. If it completes all 3 core courses gain +2 Favor.

name: Less Is More
body: Technique; During judging if you present exactly Appetizer Main and Dessert with no duplicate core course gain +5 Favor.

name: Wasabi Attack
body: Reaction; Tags: Seafood.; Choose an opponent dish. It gets -1 Taste. If it is not Seafood it gets -3 Taste instead.

name: Mangia, Mangia!
body: Technique; Draw 1. If the Judge favors your opponent draw 2 and gain 1 Time instead.

name: Mamma Mia!
body: Technique; Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand. If the Judge favors your opponent you may present it this turn.

name: Secondo
body: Technique; During judging score one Main a second time.

name: Breaking Spaghetti Is A Crime
body: Reaction; If an opponent modified a dish this turn give them a Distraction and that dish gets -2 Taste.

name: More Olive Oil!
body: Technique; Tags: Tomato, Cheese.; Choose a Tomato or Cheese dish. It gets +2 Taste. If the Judge favors your opponent it gets +3 Taste instead.

name: More Parmigiano!
body: Technique; Tags: Cheese, Tomato.; Choose a Main. It gets +2 Taste. If it is Cheese or Tomato it gets +3 Taste instead.

name: 5 Stars
body: Passive; At judging if one of your dishes has strictly more Taste than every opponent dish gain +2 Favor.

name: Bottomless Refills
body: Passive; During judging if you present an Extra gain +2 Favor.

name: Conveyor Belt
body: Passive; At the start of your turn look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

name: Nonna's Table
body: Passive; The first time each turn you present 4 or more dishes gain +2 Favor. If the Judge favors your opponent gain +3 Favor instead.

name: Steakhouse
body: Passive; Tags: Meat.; Your first Meat dish each turn gets +1 Taste. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Seafood Counter
body: Passive; Tags: Seafood.; During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.

name: Cheese Wheel
body: Passive; Tags: Cheese.; Your Cheese dishes get +1 Taste.

name: Fry Station
body: Passive; Tags: Fried.; During judging if you present a Fried dish gain +2 Favor.

name: Red Sauce Empire
body: Passive; Tags: Tomato.; Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.

name: Rice Cooker
body: Passive; Tags: Rice.; Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn. The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck even if it is not your first learned card.

name: Distraction
body: Status; No effect.
